loop: gauntlet: a builder and a separate critic with fresh context per piece. The critic runs ours next to native, names the biggest gap, and the piece loops until the critic picks ours.
bar: native APFS (this Mac) and ext4 (moonscape): cargo build and git status within 1.5x, pjdfstest + fsx + xfstests-generic no worse than native, zero data loss in crash-injection.

items.title: #7 chunking, hashing and block store
items.detail: Round-2 findings N1-N8 fixed, re-verified by me: 89 crate tests pass, fmt/clippy clean, scope clean, BlockId/ChunkRef untouched, CI green. Builder's evidence: 1800 simulated power-loss cases, 0 acked blocks lost, 0 wrong bytes, corrupt_synced reported after benign torn tail 271/1800 before, 0 after; 256 MiB pack opens in 1 ms with index, 227 ms full verified rebuild; header CRC added (format v2, 56-byte header, v1 refused); salvage(), verify_all(), acknowledge_corruption(), torn-tail sidecar, transactional roll, SYNCED base; 50 mutants 48 killed (2 equivalent); builds on Rust 1.89. Open: possible 25-35% single-thread slowdown (ingest 287 to 191 MiB/s, verified read 771 to 521) on the one clean pass, inconclusive on noisy passes; N9 cold-cache verify-on-dedup cost not measurable; sealed-pack cut at a record boundary only noticed via index checkpoint; default test time 2:17. Round-3 critic running a proper A/B of the old and new code, crash-during-recovery harness, and mutants on the new logic. | Round-3 fixes in progress (head 1c00c1e). Live CI: ubuntu FAILS at `cargo test --workspace` on the builder's in-progress head, macOS passes: a Linux-only test failure, to be checked when the builder reports (could be a real Linux bug in the new recovery code).

items.title: #10 garbage collection
items.detail: Builder writes docs/v1-gc.md first, then mark (subtree skipping, hole refs skipped, core pinned blocks via an ExtraRoots trait, epoch/grace protocol so blocks created during a mark are never swept), access-time hints (hint only), compaction (copy live records, fsync, manifest/watermark/index ordering, atomic swap), dry run, progress and cancellation. Crash injection at every compaction step, kill -9 loop, concurrent stress, negative control. Worktree slot 11, branch v1/10-gc. | Builder still working. Live CI red on both platforms at `cargo test --workspace` (head 664743c, mid-build). Must adopt the store's new pack-id allocator once #24 lands. | NOTE from the core critic: today's Core::pinned_blocks can return an EMPTY answer while a writer holds a node lock (38,372,183 of 38,374,217 polls). The core builder is making it exact or Err(Busy). GC's ExtraRoots must treat Err(Busy) as abort-the-sweep, never as 'nothing pinned'. Verify this when GC reports.

items.title: #11 Linux FUSE mount
items.detail: Critic findings fixed, re-verified by me at 98c0f24: 43 unit tests on Mac, and in the Linux VM 46 unit + 39 mount + 5 regress tests pass, no mounts left. Defaults now safe: ttl 1 s, keep_cache off, opt-in SoleWriter with an Invalidator; Vfs panics become EIO then a clean unmount; keyed-lane worker pool (slow read no longer delays stat: 856 ms to 0.2 ms, builder's n=1); signal cleanup and stale-mount sweep; inode-reuse paranoid mode. Decisions for lead: cross-adapter permission policy (FUSE denies later O_WRONLY on a 0444 file, NFS allows), SoleWriter wiring by core/control plane (invalidate from outside Vfs calls), add 'Ino never reused' text to architecture doc (done on v1/vfs-trait), add a Linux mount CI job (command in report). 2 survivors: one equivalent, one control. | ROUND-2 VERDICT: NOT mergeable. Could not break: O_APPEND (50 grow+append rounds byte-exact), panic budget, Invalidator (all 5 paths), sweep safety, permissions, signals/kill -9/remount, pjdfstest 0 regressions; 16 of 16 mutants killed (round 1: 8 survived); perf claims reproduce (head-of-line 1002 ms to 0.1 ms). Blockers: F3 create + failed open leaks the file (caller retries and gets EEXIST); F4 an empty non-eof readdir page is read as EOF, so `ls` shows nothing with no error, and a zero-based first cookie is swallowed; F1 shared-mode 'visible within a second' is false for a descriptor that stays open (stale 4 s+); F2 the crate doc promises per-inode FIFO ordering that the class-based inline/lane split does not deliver (63 getattrs on one inode inside a 4 s read; 1047 overlapping cross-directory renames); F5 is_alive() true while a lane is wedged. Builder fixing and merging main; the ordering contract was added to the trait docs (#41).

Adopted the frozen trait: Retry maps to NFS3ERR_JUKEBOX, unknown Error variants are a logged SERVERFAULT, unknown FileKind is never served as a regular file, exhaustiveness guard test, root COMMIT is the whole-mount barrier. items.title: #26 cowfs-core: Vfs over store and meta
items.detail: ROUND-2 VERDICT: NOT mergeable. Held up: conformance 132 + 2 heavy pass, crash 3 seeds x 120 ops incl. a negative control (barrier ordering holds), fsync(file) durable, directory-rename renumbering, released alias is Stale not another file, snapshot names match the CLI table. BLOCKERS: B1 fsync(ROOT_INO,false) is a no-op (the trait's whole-mount barrier; after kill the fsynced file is gone); B2 pinned_blocks() returns empty while any writer holds a node lock (38,372,183 of 38,374,217 polls returned 0 of 3 chunks), so GC could free live data; B3/B4 a failed rename_snapshot completes at the next open and leaves a visible staging snapshot, a failed promote_base leaves `base` gone from the live mount, promote_base with replace skips the name-collision check. HIGH: virt.ino missing file reads as 0 so a restore reuses inode numbers and a 0-byte marker refuses the whole mount; re-entrant aliases read lock in load_node missing from the lock audit; ns/flush locks held across fsync-bound meta commits (14-thread hammer: more than 90 s of zero progress, liveness not a cycle). MEDIUM: zero-id chunk ref reads as zeros, any flush error poisons forever, read of u32::MAX on 1 TiB sparse allocates 4 GiB, torn intent ignored. 4 mutants survive. Not run by the critic: Linux VM, fsx 1e5, 180 s hammer, 500k RSS, bench, crash during a flush. Builder fixing B1-B12 and re-merging main (metadata, trait, suite, NFS, vfs-path now on main). STILL cannot merge until #24 (store) lands. NOTE for #39: pinned_blocks must return Err(Busy) rather than a partial answer; GC must treat that as 'abort the sweep'.
